name: AIUserBubble
description: AIUserBubble renders a right-aligned message pill representing the user's sent text. Two surface variants: light (default) uses a gray (#E8E6ED) surface for chat threads on dark or brand backgrounds; dark uses a deep indigo (#1F2A66 / ZSAI[100]) fill with white text for use on white or light-gray surfaces. Both achieve WCAG AAA contrast ratios. The bubble uses Open Sans at 16px (default) or 14px (medium) with 1.55–1.4 line-height and max-width of 82%.
intent: Message container for the human user's input in a conversational AI interface. Visually distinct from AI-generated responses — positioned right-aligned with a light fill.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.
